design.name: 冰灯水母
design.brief: A floating deep-sea lantern jellyfish (水母) of the North Sea, the support: a big translucent-looking but solid bell-shaped jellyfish body with a frosted pale teal dome, a glowing aqua-cyan core lantern inside the bell (weak spot), a fringe of short frilled oral arms and a few long trailing tentacles that end in glowing beads; it floats in the air above the ice and links allies with healing tendrils of light. Calm and eerie.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, scales and fins as big simple carved shapes. The bell is drawn as a solid sculpted dome with painted translucency, the tentacles as a few thick simple bands.
design.turnaround_lead: Symmetric floating bind pose for rigging:
design.turnaround_pose: floating upright, the bell dome level and symmetric, the frilled oral arms hanging straight down in the middle, the long tentacles hanging straight down around them evenly spaced (not swirling), the core lantern inside the bell painted opaque bright aqua-cyan, bead tips opaque cyan (no halo, no light rays)
design.turnaround_digits: every tentacle fully inside the frame down to its bead tip.
